full_adder_lower_bound.scope: Stateless nodes with sequential J/K over constants, three raw input bits and earlier node values; two distinct sum/carry outputs.

input_selector.scope: reset and source anchor plus eight minimum-length three-operation mux continuations; global expression minimum not claimed

constraints: Expression minima retain exactly the original source set and the stated old-q/source preconditions.
Stateful controller and selector reductions additionally require the complete model ordering and closed reachable-state proof.
The 168-node arithmetic core and complete 512-node network are not claimed globally minimal.

checks: All declared nodes parse and are valid
Every node belongs to output dependency ancestry
Exact independent stateless ANF duplicate search with the same source/arrival interface
Fixed-point XOR / AND / reset-prefix inlining scan within the arithmetic core
Core output publication boundaries and persistent input/output states retained
graph_audit.boundary: Liveness proves only that no node is dead under direct deletion; it does not prove that restructuring cannot remove nodes. A duplicate or inlining candidate is not a safe FIFO merge until publication multiplicity, pairing, ordering and completion are proved. No global minimum node count, arbitrary graph rewrite safety, or hardware optimality is claimed.

output_protocol: Each Yi publishes nine times per complete frame, once per shared-core round, including unchanged values. Only the selected pixel output registers change q. Intermediate publications are not a complete-frame result. Read the final 72-bit output only after a complete frame has supplied all 216 inputs and the FIFO has drained.
idle_marking: Exactly one clock arrival remains in each of the nine token nodes; every other arrival cache is empty. These nine clock slots are intentionally retained for the next frame.
termination_argument: Independently proved local functions and checked complete source sets restrict the only feedback to CoreDone -> C -> Ti, Ti -> M(i+1), T8 -> Tick, selector state, and output-state readback. Arithmetic is a forward-only stateless DAG; output self-publication cannot enqueue without a fresh core-bit arrival.

One complete frame publishes FrameSeed exactly once. M0 consequently publishes once, so T0 consumes at most one M0 token. Mi receives one FrameSeed event and one event per T(i-1) publication; therefore Ti publishes at most i+1 times. T8 can produce at most nine Tick events, regardless of input values. This is a structural finite-event bound, not a conclusion inferred from a step timeout.

From the checked idle marking (one C arrival cached at every Ti), FIFO order generates token waves [T0..T8], [T1..T8], ..., [T8]. Each Tick advances the selector, reads one pixel, runs the arithmetic DAG, writes all 72 output states and then publishes CoreDone. C replenishes the token slots; each successive wave is one token shorter. After wave nine there are no remaining M arrivals, and only nine cached C arrivals remain.

The exact per-frame bound and successful schedule comprise 216 storage executions, one FrameSeed, 45 M, 45 T, nine C, nine Tick, 81 selector-state, 216 selected-input, 1512 arithmetic-core, 648 output-state and nine CoreDone executions: 2791 total. Initialization is separate: Bootstrap then C, two executions.

Bootstrap is the only source-free node and has no incoming trigger references, so it executes once with declared old q=0. Its pulse is one; constant-polynomial proofs establish FrameSeed/CoreDone pulses independently of data and old q. C always reads Bootstrap=1, M reads FrameSeed=1, T reads C=1, and Tick reads T8=1. These pulse premises are preserved around the bounded feedback and checked at actual executions.

Initially thresholds s1..s8 are all one and wrap is zero. At Tick boundaries they form a thermometer and old_wrap AND old_s8=0. Wrap reads old_s8 first; its new value being one implies every old threshold is one. Descending s8..s1 updates read each unchanged predecessor and produce the next thermometer (8 wraps to 0); new_wrap AND new_s8 remains zero. Local transition enumeration proves this invariant inductively, and the FIFO trace checks old q, source reads and update order.
evidence_boundary: Exhaustive 24-bit shared-core arithmetic, plus actual FIFO checks of sampled 216-bit frames, exact finite token waves, saved input and conditional output state, reset/reload and specified idle caches. Not an enumeration of all 2^216 frame inputs or arbitrary state/event interleavings.
